description: During the Gemini VIII emergency, Armstrong undocked and used re-entry controls to regain control before an emergency landing.
Armstrong served as Apollo 11 commander and piloted the first crewed lunar landing mission.
Armstrong coordinated NASA aeronautics research and technology work and helped transfer digital fly-by-wire technology to industry.
Aldrin systematically developed procedures and tools for orbital rendezvous, docking, and extravehicular activity.
Aldrin developed rendezvous and EVA methods described by NASA as critical to Gemini and Apollo operations.
King accepted leadership of the Montgomery bus boycott and sustained an explicitly nonviolent civil-rights campaign.
King continued the 382-day boycott despite arrest, bombing of his home, violence, and personal abuse.
Mandela continued political leadership after decades of imprisonment and became ANC president after release.
Mandela and de Klerk were recognized for work toward peaceful termination of apartheid and a democratic South Africa.
Mandela became the first democratically elected president of South Africa after helping lay foundations for the new democratic state.
Gates co-founded Microsoft and led it as a major software and services organization.
Gates co-founded and led a company centered on business and personal software and services.
Gates helped establish and direct a durable foundation working across global health, development, and education.
